svg.text: Reactive, short-lived intermediates formed by heterolytic bond fission
6 valence electrons on C (sextet) – electron-deficient, an electrophile
, lone pair in a hybrid orbital
8 valence electrons on C – electron-rich, a nucleophile / base
Stability of carbocations (more alkyl groups → more +I and hyperconjugation → more stable)
Carbanion stability runs the opposite way: CH
> 1° > 2° > 3° (alkyl groups push electrons onto an already electron-rich carbon)
Both are further stabilised by resonance (allyl, benzyl) – e.g. benzyl cation C
